# Ecochain

> ISO-compliant LCA software platform for automated product footprints, EPDs, and sustainability compliance with CSRD, CPR, and CBAM regulations.

Ecochain provides Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) software and environmental intelligence tools for manufacturers and businesses to measure, manage, and report product environmental impacts. The platform supports compliance with EU sustainability regulations including the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), Construction Products Regulation (CPR), and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), while enabling circular economy initiatives and data-driven sustainability decisions.

## Key Topics

- Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
- Environmental Product Declarations (EPD)
- Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD)
- Product Carbon Footprint (PCF)
- Construction Products Regulation (CPR)
- Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
- Greenhouse Gas Protocol
- Scope 3 emissions
- Ecochain LCA software
- Circular economy
- Ecodesign
- EN 15804+A2
- Sustainability compliance
- Environmental intelligence
- ISO 14040/14044
